thesis: The scoring engine says “Apply and hold for the long term” for holding (83/100) and “Apply for listing-day gains” for listing day, from 70% of the data it needs.

Next to similar companies a share looks worth about ₹284.82, against the ₹162 asking price.

sentences: 5 similar listed companies trade at 19.6x to 21.7x their yearly profit (middle: 20.2x), 4 of 5 at today's market prices.
Applied to its earnings per share of ₹3.52 in Q1FY27 (₹14.08 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹276.25 (low), ₹284.82 (middle) or ₹305.96 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹162, the middle value means 75.8% upside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
Cross-check: at the peers' middle EV/EBITDA of 14.5x, after taking off net debt, a share would be worth ₹302.85 against ₹284.82 from P/E: the two agree.
This is a rough guide, not a forecast: it assumes the company deserves the same price tag as its listed peers.
